question: Should schema 10 and source-revision/observation-sequence ordering become the supported persisted-state contract for existing gitcrawl archives?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and well-proven, but accepting a permanent on-disk schema and conflict-resolution contract requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt the contract
options.body: Merge after the store/sync owner confirms the schema-10 upgrade and final ordering semantics represented by this head.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Keep the draft open and separate schema convergence from hydration ordering if maintainers want a narrower compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt the contract
recommendation.body: Merge after the store/sync owner confirms the schema-10 upgrade and final ordering semantics represented by this head.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the dominant recent merged history for the exact store and synchronization behavior being formalized.
